# Beryllium: Feature Matrix

<!-- Generated by freebsd/tools/feature-matrix from plan/feature-matrix.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Status as of 2026-11-04, latest release v0.20.3.1-1. Every feature the project must implement, build and test, with where it is specified, the code that does it, and the test that proves it. Edit `plan/feature-matrix.toml` and run `freebsd/tools/feature-matrix`; CI rejects a row that claims a test, code or source the repository does not have.

## Legend

| Column | Values |
|---|---|
| Priority | **must**: needed for the first release (plan/09); **should**: wanted for it; **later**: after it; **study**: decide first |
| Phase | roadmap phase (plan/09): 0 baseline, 1 native build, 2 Capsicum renderer, 3 other processes, 4 jail and resources, 5 MAC study, 6 release engineering |
| Implemented | **done**; **partial**; **todo**; **inherited**: Chromium or Helium code Beryllium keeps as it is; **disabled**: present but off in Beryllium (the row says why) |
| Built | the release whose package contains it, or **no** |
| Tested | **passing** / **failing**: the test's latest recorded run on FreeBSD (Evidence names the build, machine and date); **manual**: checked by hand (Evidence); **written**: the test exists, with no passing run recorded on the current release; **planned**: the plan names a test, not written yet; **none**: no test planned |

## Browser functionality

What a user does with the browser on FreeBSD. Evidence "owner, 0.20.3.1" means the maintainer's machine: FreeBSD 16.0-CURRENT, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop (driver 595.99.02), KDE Plasma on Wayland. "15.1 package" runs were made on the same machine on 3 November 2026, before the release; the browser suite has not yet been rerun in full on the release.

## Privacy

What Beryllium promises about the network and the user's data, and the privacy features it inherits from Helium and ungoogled-chromium.

### Online services

| ID | Feature | Priority | Phase | Implemented | Built | Tested | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P-SVC-01` | **Services off by default, Helium's servers never used.** Online services are off in a new profile and no setting or setup step sends anything to Helium's servers (services.helium.imput.net, helium.computer). *Not met in 0.20.3.1: Helium's default is helium.services.enabled=true with Helium's address, held back only until the user consents on the setup page. No Beryllium patch changes it. The idle privacy test passes because it skips the setup page.* | must | 1 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>privacy capture through the setup page with its defaults accepted: no request to a Helium host | plan/01-PROJECT-CHARTER.md D3<br>plan/07-PRIVACY-INVARIANTS-PLAN.md §3<br>helium/patches/helium/core/services-prefs.patch<br>helium/patches/helium/core/onboarding-page.patch |
| `P-SVC-02` | **Security components stay current.** Certificate revocation lists, Certificate Transparency logs and the uBlock component are updated from a source Beryllium controls. *These components age in every installed copy until this is done.* | must | 6 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>release gate; privacy suite with a hostile mock origin (bad packages rejected, no downgrade) | plan/10-RISKS-AND-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md R13<br>plan/10-RISKS-AND-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q10<br>plan/09-ROADMAP.md §9 |

## Security

The sandbox and hardening work, Beryllium's reason to exist. Nothing in this area confines a process yet: the release ships with no sandbox, and says so.

### Capsicum renderer sandbox

| ID | Feature | Priority | Phase | Implemented | Built | Tested | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `S-REN-01` | **Renderers in capability mode.** Every production renderer enters Capsicum capability mode before it handles web content, and the browser checks it with the kernel. *The imported FreeBSD sandbox code only lowers RLIMIT_DATA.* | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **written**<br>`freebsd/tests/browser/tests/test_50_sandbox.py::test_capability_mode_per_process`<br>records each process's mode with procstat; asserts nothing until renderers are confined | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §3.1<br>RT-04 |
| `S-REN-02` | **Warm-up before lockdown.** Everything a renderer needs from the system (uname, memory size, time zones, fonts, locale, libraries) is read before cap_enter. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>functional suite run with the sandbox on and off; oracle probes misc.localtime, proc.dlopen, id.vm_page_count | plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §2<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §3.1<br>plan/03-ARCHITECTURE.md §4.5<br>plan/10-RISKS-AND-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md R5 |
| `S-REN-03` | **Descriptor inventory.** A diagnostic build records every descriptor a renderer holds, per workload: who opened it, why, its rights and the test that proves it is needed. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>diagnostic build with PROC_TRAPCAP_CTL over the functional workloads; feeds S-REN-04 | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.2<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §2 |
| `S-REN-04` | **Descriptor allowlist.** A renderer's descriptors equal a committed allowlist (stdio, the Mojo socketpair, resource paks, V8 snapshot, passed shared memory and fonts); anything extra aborts. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: descriptor set equals freebsd/sandbox/renderer-fds.json; a descriptor added by an update is caught | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §3.2<br>RT-14 |
| `S-REN-05` | **Least rights on each descriptor.** Every descriptor a renderer keeps is limited with cap_rights_limit, and its ioctls and fcntls to an allowlist. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: rights per descriptor (procstat -f -C) match the policy | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §3.2 |
| `S-REN-06` | **No file system access.** A renderer holds no directory, profile, cookie, cache or download descriptor; path opens fail; user files arrive only as handles the browser passes. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: no directory descriptors outside the allowlist; forbidden opens fail with the oracle's errno | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §13.1 |
| `S-REN-07` | **No network access.** A renderer has no socket except its Mojo channel; connect, bind, sendto and name lookups fail. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: socket creation and connect fail; oracle net.* probes | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.3 |
| `S-REN-08` | **Children stay confined.** A renderer cannot exec or load libraries by path, and any child it makes inherits capability mode. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: child of a renderer stays confined; oracle proc.fork_inherits, proc.execve, proc.dlopen | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §13.1 |
| `S-REN-09` | **Fail closed.** In the production package any sandbox setup failure ends the renderer; the separate beryllium-devel package may run unconfined and says NOT SANDBOXED. *The devel port exists; the build flag beryllium_sandbox_required does not.* | must | 2 | **partial**<br>`freebsd/ports/www/beryllium-devel/Makefile` | no | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: injected setup failure is fatal and logged; no fallback to an unrestricted renderer | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §2.3<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §3.4<br>plan/01-PROJECT-CHARTER.md D5 |
| `S-REN-10` | **No escape-hatch switches.** The production package ignores --no-sandbox, launcher prefixes, --js-flags, site-isolation and web-security switches, remote debugging and --load-extension, and its wrapper adds none. *Only the wrapper part is done. Remote debugging and --load-extension are not in the RT-12 list yet.* | must | 2 | **partial**<br>`freebsd/ports/www/beryllium/files/beryllium.in` | v0.20.3.1-1 | **planned**<br>sandbox suite: switch-table diff; --no-sandbox has no effect in production | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §6.1<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §3.4<br>RT-12 |
| `S-REN-11` | **Attacker hook for testing.** A devel-only switch runs the red-team probes inside each confined process type; it is absent from production builds. | must | 2 | **todo** | no | **planned**<br>build test proving the hook is absent from production | plan/12-WORK-PLAN-AND-RED-TEAM.md §6<br>plan/08-TESTING-AND-VERIFICATION.md §2.2 |
| `S-REN-12` | **Site isolation.** Each site gets its own renderer process. | should | 2 | **inherited** | v0.20.3.1-1 | **planned**<br>functional suite: two sites in two tabs run in two renderers (procstat) | helium-freebsd-security-port-spec.md §13.3<br>plan/06-SECURITY-MODEL.md §11 |
